难道他真的是天才？（难道他真的是天才？（第22页）浮雕着巨兽盘踞的暗红鼎盖上，还有着一个特殊的孔洞，这是专门投入药材的地方。在鼎盖上，散布着一些用冰银打造的细密孔洞，这有着散热的功效，以防止高温而导致爆炉，药鼎中间的部分，安置了一块由寒冰精打造而成的透明镜面，从这里，能够在炼药时，清楚的看见里面的一切动静。望着这尊外表华丽的药鼎，萧炎皱了皱眉。这药鼎品质其实还不错，就是这设计的图案有一股太过浮夸的暴发户味道，令他有些不喜，这制造药鼎的人，审美不行。“嗯，两口之鼎，这对于你这种新手来说，还算不错吧。”瞟了一眼暗红药鼎上面的两个兽口，药老淡淡道。“两口之鼎？”萧炎疑惑地眨了眨眼。“药鼎也有级别之分，鼎炉的通火口越多，则说明药鼎越高级，也越稀有，你别以为这种火口是随便打几个洞就成，里面的奥妙，外行人根本难以发觉。这火口，乃是药鼎的精华所在，需要高精度的打磨，打造期间，只要稍有一点差错，整个药鼎，都将会沦为失败品，所以，火口越多的药鼎，对炼药的辅助效果也更强。当然，想要控制多个火口，那就需要强大的灵魂感知力，像你这种初学者，第一次炼药就能控制两个火口，就已经很不错了。”药老笑了笑，解释道。略微有些恍然的点了点头，萧炎望着面前的药鼎，问道：“接下来该怎么办？”“你还是先熟悉一下药鼎吧，把你的一只手按在火口之上，然后调动体内的异火，进入其中。”药老悬浮在半空，指挥道。点了点头，萧炎触摸着火口，眼眸微闭，体内那血红色的气旋微微波动，一道红色的火焰沿着经脉，从掌心喷涌而出，通过火口，钻进了药鼎之中，不断翻腾燃烧。“唉，别人炼药，都是从斗气转化火焰开始的，你小子倒好，省略了这一步不说，用的火焰都直接是异火，这等运气，当真是令人羡慕！”望着药鼎内翻腾的火焰，药老也忍不住摇头感慨起来。闻言，萧炎也是眉头一挑，摸了摸自己的鼻子。他也未曾想过，会在斗者阶段，便如此侥幸地获得了异火。“不过单纯的异火，并不是炼药之火，现在你沉神控制体内的那一丝木属性，然后将之灌注进药鼎之内！”萧炎依言的闭上双眼，心神缓缓凝定，凭借出色的灵魂感知力，直接在足厥阴肝经之中，寻找到了那一丝木之力，睁开双眼，伸出一根手指，轻点在另外一只火口之上，一道极为微薄的绿色气流，被灌注而进。绿色气流刚刚进入药鼎，里面本来还有些狂暴的万兽灵火，犹如被驯服的野兽一般，骤然间安静下来，在萧炎的灵魂感知力中，火焰里的狂暴因子，已经被木之力中和，而且此时的火焰，明显比先前，要更加持久，更容易掌控。“这就找到了？”见到萧炎眼睛一闭一睁，就找到了木之力，药老直接眼珠子都要瞪出来了。

Chapter 17 Is he really a genius (page 1)
Is he really a genius? (Is he really a genius? (Page 22)) There is a special hole on the dark red cauldron cover with the giant beast entrenched in relief, which is a place where medicinal materials are put in. On the cauldron cover, there are some fine holes made of ice silver, which have the effect of dissipating heat to prevent the high temperature from causing the furnace to explode. In the middle part of the medicine cauldron, a transparent mirror made of ice essence is placed. From here, when refining medicine, He could clearly see everything going on inside. Looking at the gorgeous-looking medicine cauldron, Xiao Yan frowned. The quality of the medicine cauldron was actually quite good, but the design had an overly exaggerated nouveau riche vibe, which made him a little unhappy. The person who made the medicine cauldron was not good at aesthetics. "Well, a tripod with two mouths, this is not bad for a novice like you." He glanced at the two animal mouths on the dark red medicine cauldron and said calmly. "A two-mouth cauldron?" Xiao Yan blinked in confusion. "Medicine cauldrons also have levels. The more flame openings there are in the cauldron, the higher the grade and the rarer the medicinal cauldron. Don't think that this kind of flame vent can be made by just drilling a few holes. The secret inside is difficult for a layman to detect. This flame port is the essence of the medicinal cauldron and requires high-precision polishing. If there is even a slight mistake during the building process, the entire medicinal cauldron will fail. Therefore, the medicine cauldron with more fire ports will have a stronger auxiliary effect on refining medicine. Of course, if you want to control multiple fire ports, you need strong soul perception. It is already good for a beginner like you to control two fire ports for the first time." Yao Lao smiled and explained. Xiao Yan nodded slightly, looking at the medicine cauldron in front of him, and asked: "What should I do next?" "You better get familiar with it first? Press the medicine cauldron, put one of your hands on the fire port, and then mobilize the strange fire in the body to enter it." Yao Lao suspended in the air and commanded. Nodding, Xiao Yan touched the fire port, his eyes were slightly closed, the blood-red cyclone in the body fluctuated slightly, and a red flame spurted out from the palm along the meridians, passed through the fire port, and penetrated into the medicine cauldron, constantly churning and burning. "Oh, others make medicine from Dou Qi. You're the one who started the process of transforming the flames. You'd better omit this step. The flames used are all strange fires. This kind of luck is really enviable!" Looking at the flames churning in the medicine cauldron, Yao Lao couldn't help but shake his head and sighed. Hearing this, Xiao Yan also raised his eyebrows and touched his nose. He never thought that he would be so lucky to obtain the strange fires in the fighter stage. "But pure strange fires are not refining medicine. Fire, now you concentrate on controlling the trace of wood attribute in your body, and then pour it into the medicine cauldron!" Xiao Yan closed his eyes as instructed, and slowly concentrated his mind. With his excellent soul perception, he found the trace of wood power directly in the Zujueyin Liver Meridian. He opened his eyes, stretched out a finger, and tapped on the other fire mouth. A very thin green air flow was poured in. The green air flow had just entered. The medicine cauldron, which originally contained some violent beast spirit fire, suddenly became quiet like a tamed beast. In Xiao Yan's soul perception, the violent factors in the flames had been neutralized by the power of wood, and the flames at this time were obviously more durable and easier to control than before. "Have you found it?" Seeing Xiao Yan closing and opening his eyes to find the power of wood, Yao Lao's eyes almost popped out.
